plain: A small group of soldiers or police sent off from a larger force on a special job

webster.text: The act of detaching or separating.

more.text: A body of troops, selected or taken from the main army, and employed on some special service or expedition.
A number of ships, taken from a fleet, and sent on a separate service.

example.quote: These garrisons must either be furnished by occasional detachments from the militia, or by permanent corps in the pay of the government.
